description: Congressman Rob Bresnahan stood beside President Trump in the Oval Office as the President signed an executive order officially ending the federal "Rain Tax" mandate that has drained the wallets of homeowners and small business owners across Northeastern Pennsylvania for over a decade. While Rob Bresnahan was fighting to eliminate the Rain Tax, Paige Cognetti set off to Chicago this summer for a fundraiser hosted by Jon Carson, the man who bragged about authoring the Rain Tax executive order.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Rob for PA
title: Rob Bresnahan Ends Federal “Rain Tax” Mandate, Paige Cognetti Owned By Its Creators - Rob for PA
